title: TFSA, FHSA, Or RRSP: Which Comes First?

research_notes: TFSA, FHSA, and RRSP rules can change and should be verified with CRA before publication.
FHSA tax treatment depends on qualifying withdrawals for a first home.
Employer RRSP matches vary by plan and should be described generally.

scenes.narration: If you live in Canada, the hard part is not finding an account. It is choosing which one gets your next dollar. Here is the simple version.

scenes.narration: After that, if you are saving for a first home, the FHSA deserves serious attention. It can give you a tax deduction going in, and tax-free growth when the money is used for a qualifying first home.
scenes.subtitle: First home money may point to the FHSA.

scenes.narration: Then compare RRSP and TFSA. RRSPs can help more when your tax rate is high today. TFSAs are more flexible because withdrawals are tax-free and the room generally comes back later.
scenes.subtitle: RRSP today. TFSA flexibility.
